question: Do fixed labels beside repeated plant fragments recur in the corresponding distant herbal prose more specifically than in comparable pages?
parsing: All prose rows kind[1]==P, excluding ! alternative rows. Drawing gaps <-> delimit words; remove other angle metadata; dots delimit. Two global treatments of comma: split to dot, or join by removal. Admit only entire lowercase a-z tokens; discard uncertain tokens without repairs. Keep loci, split indices, exclusions and duplicates. EVA ASCII codepoints, not asserted glyphs or phonemes.
label_rule: All three exact labels as recorded in PAIRS.json, same locus in ZL/IT; no prefix, suffix, synonym, cross-token or normalization search.
page_length_control: Per transcription/segmentation K=min retained token count over all 16 eligible pages. Exact presence probability for uniform K-token subset without replacement: 1-C(N-c,K)/C(N,K). No random sampling.
primary: Mean of three rarefied exact-presence probabilities under specified assignment. Report raw exact occurrences and locations for every label/page.
secondary: Levenshtein edit distance/max(label length, token length), whole EVA tokens only. Report all ties at raw minimum and expected minimum in a uniform K-token subset analytically from sorted distances. Descriptive only, no acceptance threshold.
reference_assignments: All 24 permutations of four physical bifolio blocks [[17,24],[18,23],[19,22],[20,21]], retaining member and r/v positions. Apply one permutation jointly to all labels. Real identity assignment included; paired fragments212/213 stay on same bifolio face. Report fraction with primary>=observed, secondary<=observed; these are conditional reference ranks, not calibrated historical p-values.
decision: No semantic inference from a positive association. No exact hits means this small set supplies no exact lexical bridge under these readings/segmentations, not absence of meaning or rejection of all possible inflections. No new rules added after result.
limitations: Three labels, two source panels on same physical folio, two target bifolios; nonrandom exposed material and published visual judgements. Prior atlas/source exposure, not historically blind holdout. ZL/IT share manuscript/conventions. Unknown origin of historical visual selection; exploratory not confirmatory.
prior_work_difference: Phase14: labels vs own pharmaceutical prose; phase15: learned rewrites; here fixed published fragment-to-distant-herbal association, with no learned rewriting.
